hardware.host: eight H200 GPUs; two Intel Xeon Platinum 8558 CPUs
hardware.workers: up to eight on separate GPUs; 20 logical CPUs per worker; numerical-library threads limited to four

protocol.trials: One measured run after one warm-up in a separate process; no repeated-trial statistics.
protocol.inputs: Demo workloads, lengths, dimensions, supplied prerequisites and software differ.
protocol.timing: CUDA synchronization at stage boundaries; stages follow each implementation. Load is separate; Proc is whole-process elapsed time, not TTFF or a phase sum.
protocol.memory: NVML samples the process and descendants every 100 ms over the whole process, including loading and auxiliary stages. The sampled peak can miss short allocations. Framework counters are retained separately.
protocol.limits: No matched quality evaluation, streaming TTFF, sustained service or long-session drift measurement. Shared host resources and varying NUMA locality remain.
protocol.missing: Pending rows have null numerical and configuration fields; CSV fields are empty. Missing results are not zero.
